figurative_meaning_en: Infatuation or weakness towards another man's wife
example_sentences_in_bangla: সমাজে পরস্ত্রীকাতরতা কখনো ক্ষমা করা হয় না।
example_sentences_in_english: His infatuation with another man's wife is amusing everyone.
Society never forgives such weakness towards someone else's spouse.
note: This idiom often appears in satirical or moralistic Bengali literature to critique male folly.
